messages.subject: methylKit v0.5.7 is out
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
New version of methylKit compatible with R 3.0 and corresponding bioconductor dependencies is now available.

To install copy-paste the following in R console,

source("http://methylkit.googlecode.com/files/install.methylKit.R")

# installing the package with the dependencies
install.methylKit(ver="0.5.7",dependencies=TRUE)

In addition, we have a new Q&A forum to ask questions, you can send your questions directly to  methylkit_...@googlegroups.com or post a question using the web interface <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/methylkit_discussion>.

Best,
Altuna
